tasks.label: launch-vulkan-emulator
tasks.command: bash -c 'nohup ~/Android/Sdk/emulator/emulator -avd Pixel_Tablet -gpu host -no-snapshot -feature -Vulkan > /dev/null 2>&1 & disown; ~/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb -e wait-for-device; while [ "$(~/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb -e shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r")" != "1" ]; do sleep 1; done; sleep 5'

tasks.label: launch-google-tv-emulator
tasks.command: bash -c 'nohup ~/Android/Sdk/emulator/emulator -avd Google_TV_1080p -no-snapshot-load > /dev/null 2>&1 & disown; ~/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb -e wait-for-device; while [ "$(~/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb -e shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\r")" != "1" ]; do sleep 1; done; sleep 5'
